name: Category workspace UI
goal: Implement CategoryPage using the supplied API-CONTRACT.md, typed api.ts and React Query. Keep the page under 6000 characters. Tester writes four focused interaction tests.
acceptance_criteria: Lookup by Category code with Find category shows returned name/path/depth and calls getCategory with trimmed code.
Lookup errors show actual error.message in role=alert; requests have pending feedback and disabled actions.
Creation labels New category code, New category name, New parent code send trimmed code/name and parentCode:null for blank parent through createCategory.
After loading, Category name and Parent code allow Save changes through updateCategory(code,{name,parentCode,updateParent:true}); code stays immutable and blank parent becomes null.
Blank required inputs prevent requests. Heading Categories, success feedback, no list/delete endpoints. Tests use renderPage, mock ./api and await interactions.
